source.note: Kenney delivery box truck (FBX like car-sedan, car-van and the other kit cars, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member). Real size: height 2.8 m, matched to a small box truck (Isuzu Elf / Hino Dutro class, about 2.6-3.2 m tall and 4.7-6.5 m long); that makes it 5.51 m long and 2.54 m wide over the mirrors (body about 2.2 m). Kenney's toy proportions leave the wheels oversized at this scale (about 1.1 m across). maxColors 40 so the colour map's white-to-lavender gradient splits the windows from the cab. White box with a red cab (indigo accent with a sky shade), distinct from the all-red sedan, white sports sedan, cream hatchback, yellow taxi, black/white police car, light-blue van and orange SUV; the source's green box is white here. The slatted rear roller door reads as stripes through the lower pair. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
